IMPORTANT: The application portal will be closed at 9am, 02 November 2026 AEDT as we transition to a new application form to be launched in mid to late January 2027. In the interim no new or incomplete applications can be submitted.
All complete applications submitted before 02 November 2026 will be assessed before the end of 2026. Incomplete applications will be deleted.
We accept applications for research degrees across the year. If you have confirmed funding through a faculty scholarship, external scholarship, IDP or are self-funding, you can apply at any time. To be considered for a scholarship, you need to apply by the closing dates.
The application process can take some time. We recommend starting the pre-application process at least six weeks before the closing date if you plan to apply for a scholarship. This will give you time to connect with your potential faculty, prepare documents and submit your application.
Scholarship deadlines
Use the buttons to expand or collapse the section.
The below closing dates apply if you’re seeking a UTS competitive scholarship, and you:
are applying for a PhD or Master's by Research degree
are already enrolled in a UTS research program, or
have received your offer of admission to a UTS research program.
All applications for UTS scholarships are assessed competitively against the University’s scholarship assesesment criteria, including academic qualifications and relevant work experience; research outputs and achievements; alignment with faculty research priorities; and the quality of the research proposal.
Applications or certified documents (if required) submitted after the scholarship deadline will be considered for candidature only.
Applications that do not meet the English language requirements will not be assessed and will be closed.
Learn more about how to fund your research degree.
2027 & 2028 scholarship deadline

Start, enrolment and census dates
Use the buttons to expand or collapse the section.
There are different start, enrolment and census dates for research and coursework programs. Research students can undertake coursework subjects, which means you will need to comply with both the coursework and research dates.
Your start date will be provided in your Letter of Offer. You can agree on a different date with your faculty and supervisor. If you have coursework subjects in your research program, you may need to commence before the coursework census date.
The last day to enrol is the last day you can:
enrol for your research program within the session
add a coursework subject to your research program for that session, and
swap a coursework class time.
How to complete your enrolment.
The census date is the last day to withdraw from a subject or degree without academic penalty.
